description: He wears a long teal-blue textured noble coat with wide sleeves over crossed-front brown-gold patterned underlayers. Gold plant-scroll woven borders run along the collar, front, sleeve ends and hem; small animal motifs appear near the coat's lower edge. A dark teal waist sash is overlaid with a burgundy-and-gold decorated sash whose long fringed ends hang in front. Round gold medallions and linked hanging ornaments attach near the waist. Loose dark trousers tuck into calf-high dark brown leather boots decorated with gold scroll shapes. No headgear or weapons appear.
